'''Trandosite''' was a UK SWCCG fan site run by [[Rod Latham]] ('''The Unknown Trandoshan'''; anagram handle Res Luk Ra'auf). Latham started it in October 1998. Its last homepage update, a shutdown notice, is dated 9 July 2001.<ref name="main">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050405041003/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/main.htm main.htm], Trandosite (Wayback 5 April 2005; frames wrapper [https://web.archive.org/web/20050405041003fw_/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/main.htm fw_])</ref> The site billed itself as Europe's main SWCCG site, with news, articles, decks, UK tournament coverage, a 2000 Worlds qualifier board and player interviews.<ref name="main" />

== What it had ==

The site's sections were:<ref name="main" />

* Today's News · Deck Clinic · World Finals 2000
* What Is SWCCG? · Articles · Mini-Articles · Decks · Tournament Reports
* Interviews · UK Tournament Area · Have/Want List · Links · Xtra: Archives · Staff Writers

'''Decks''' (post–Death Star II, Light / Dark / other / archives) held tournament-viable lists sorted by strategy (ROps, Hunt Down, BHBM, …).<ref name="decks">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050405041003/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/decks.htm decks.htm], Trandosite (Wayback)</ref> The lists are at [[Trandosite decks]]. '''World Championships 2000''' was a qualifier table (country and championship seat) with links to Worlds-finals history and wild-card results.<ref name="worlds00">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050405085911/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/worlds00.htm worlds00.htm], Trandosite (Wayback 5 April 2005)</ref>

'''Staff:''' Rod Latham (webmaster, Taunton), Alex Tennet (assistant webmaster, Newcastle), Rob Ronnlund, Eric Bailey, Dan Mailloux.<ref name="staff">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050405041003/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/staff.htm staff.htm], Trandosite (Wayback)</ref>

== Interviews ==

Trandosite ran sixteen player interviews from April to October 2000, mostly by Latham (some with Alex Tennet / B. Beveridge).<ref name="interview">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050405092737/http://trandosite.mcmail.com/interview.htm interview.htm], Trandosite (Wayback 5 April 2005)</ref> Full copies are on the player pages and indexed at [[Interviews]].
